# Security Policy

## Supported versions

**No general-availability release is supported yet.** Development branches, beta artifacts and draft releases are provided for testing only and should not be treated as supported production software.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not disclose a vulnerability, exploit, user data or credentials in a public GitHub issue**.

Use the **"Report a vulnerability"** private reporting flow in the repository's [Security tab](https://github.com/nocturney/slicebridge/security), which is enabled for this repository.

Include a concise description, affected version/commit and platform, reproduction steps and impact. Share sensitive reproduction material only via an appropriate private channel. We will triage reports on a best-effort basis; no response or remediation deadline is promised while the product remains in development.

When a security issue is fixed and a release exists, the project may publish an advisory and corrected release.
